item: copy image (thread + popup): a hover copy button on every image a tool returned, and a Copy button beside the popup's ×; both send the image to the IDE clipboard through Kotlin
branch: toolImages() (js/50-blocks.js) wraps each .ti in a .ti-wrap with a .ti-copy button (marked .small when the image is too narrow to carry it); the click and the lightbox's .lb-copy (chat.html, js/30-menus.js) go through copyImage() (js/20-markdown.js), which redraws the image on a canvas and sends bridge{kind:'copyImage', data:<PNG base64>}; ChatPanel.kt decodes it with ImageIO and sets an image Transferable on CopyPasteManager
provenance: The tool_result image block {type:'image', source:{type:'base64', media_type, data}} is the live shape documented on toolImages (taken from a real record, client-parity item 8); the PNGs are generated solid-colour 64x40 and 12x12 images. Nothing new is claimed about the CLI: this is page behaviour plus the bridge ask. The Kotlin half (clipboard really holds an image) is checked by hand with xclip -t image/png, not here.

steps.note: 1 — live: Read returns two images → each sits in its own .ti-wrap with ONE copy button; the 12px one is marked small (button beside it, not over it)
steps.setup: window.onClaudeEvent(JSON.stringify({type:'__clear'})); addUserMessage('look', [], Date.now()); if (!window.__realBridge101) { window.__realBridge101 = window.__bridge; } window.__tape101 = []; window.__bridge = function(j){ window.__tape101.push(JSON.parse(j)); };

expect.why: exactly one copy button per image
only the image narrower than the button's room is marked small
hidden until the image is hovered

steps.note: 2 — click the thread button: the image goes to Kotlin as PNG base64 (bridge{kind:'copyImage'}), the glyph flashes to the check, the lightbox does NOT open

expect.why: the payload decodes to the clicked image at its natural size
check glyph while the flash lasts
the copy click is not an open click

steps.note: 3 — the popup: clicking the image opens it with a Copy button beside ×; Copy sends the shown image and leaves the popup open

expect.why: one copy button in the popup

expect.js: new Promise(function(r){ var b=document.querySelector('#lightbox .lb-copy'); if (b) b.click(); setTimeout(function(){ r(JSON.stringify(window.__tape101.map(function(o){return o.kind}))) }, 400); })

expect.why: the payload is the image the popup shows
copy does not close the popup

steps.note: 4 — cleanup: close the popup, restore the real bridge
